name: niche-prior-art-benchmark
purpose: Reproducible comparison of codebase-context against credited prior art on team-convention lookup, edit-preflight navigation, and symbol retrieval. Not patch quality or agent productivity.

comparators.credit: This repository (local dist CLI / MCP surfaces).
jCodeMunch MCP symbol search and repo indexing (jcodemunch-mcp on PyPI).
Paul Gauthier's Aider RepoMap ranking (aider-chat on PyPI). Query tokens are passed as mentioned identifiers; there is no separate natural-language search API.

Repomix repository packing (repomix on npm). Repomix does not expose query-specific retrieval; the lane charges pack generation to index time and ranks files by scanning pack sections for query tokens.
BurntSushi ripgrep JSON search over the repo checkout. No index; measures lexical retrieval only.

accuracy.definition: Share of tasks where any expectedFilePattern appears in the first three ranked paths returned by the lane.

tokens.definition: UTF-8 payload bytes divided by four (same heuristic as discovery benchmark).

latency.definition: Wall time for the lane query step; index and setup are reported separately and amortized per repo where applicable.

fairnessRules: Task queries and expected patterns are frozen in tests/fixtures/niche-benchmark-manifest.json before benchmark code ships.
All lanes receive the same natural-language query string per task.
Do not adjust expected patterns after observing lane outputs.
Do not add task-specific ranking heuristics to codebase-context for this benchmark.
Report setup_failed lanes honestly; do not treat missing competitors as wins.
Credit prior art by display name and project URL in public docs.
